briefings.headline: Make deGrom earn every out
briefings.message: Jacob deGrom is the likely starter with high confidence. Be ready for velocity and stay disciplined against his slider and other breaking balls. Hunt a fastball you can drive; Yordan Alvarez has the clearest favorable matchup, and Jeremy Peña, Cam Smith, and Yainer Diaz also have fastball opportunities. If he exits, watch for left-handers Jacob Latz and Tyler Alexander, or right-hander Chase Silseth in a key spot.
reminders: Yordan Alvarez: sit breaking balls; lay off offspeed.
Right-handed hitters: don’t expand against the slider.
Stay patient and make deGrom work.

briefings.message: Hunter Brown starts, with a 95-pitch limit. In a close game, use Bryan Abreu and Bryan King for the toughest pockets, with Josh Hader available for the highest-risk inning and as the primary ninth-inning option.
reminders: Be careful with Brandon Nimmo; use offspeed rather than leaning on fastballs.
Steven Okert has 40 pitches in the last 3 days.
